title: syncarpia procera var. glabra
intro: Syncarpia procera var. glabra, commonly known as the Smooth Ironwood, is a variety of tree native to Australia, characterized by its smooth, grey bark and glossy leaves. The Smooth Ironwood has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and wounds, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the Smooth Ironwood include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
